name: openmm
description: Run OpenMM 8.5 MD (PME, HBonds, LangevinMiddle, mixed precision) on Aurora Intel PVC tiles via platform='OpenCL'; one row per system from AMBER/GROMACS/CHARMM/PDB inputs, returns a DCD trajectory + final state. No ligand parameterization.
_timeout_note: 3600s default. Verified smoke: 5000 steps on a 2269-atom system ~2.1s compute + ~10s startup/JIT. Scale with nsteps and system size; bump for large systems or long runs.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). GPU platform is 'OpenCL' (NOT 'CUDA'/'SYCL'); DeviceIndex stays 0 (ZE_AFFINITY_MASK exposes one tile). 'required' is empty because the needed input keys differ by input_type; the runner enforces them per-type (amber->prmtop+inpcrd, gromacs->gro+top, charmm->psf+crd+params, pdb->pdb). VERIFIED path = input_type='amber' (prmtop/inpcrd, example above). TODO(verify): input_type='gromacs'/'charmm'/'pdb' use documented standard OpenMM app readers but were NOT live-tested on Aurora.
_example_todo_verify: confirm the openmm-sycl examples/python-examples/input.{prmtop,inpcrd} paths are worker-visible.
